title: Build an Accordion
description: Build an Accordion component where users can expand or collapse sections to reveal content. By default all sections should remain collapsed. Clicking a section header should toggle its content visibility.
requirements: Render a list of accordion items.
Clicking a header expands its content.
Clicking an already expanded header collapses it.
Only one accordion section should remain open at a time.
State should update instantly on user interaction.
bonusRequirements: Allow multiple sections to remain open simultaneously.

accordionItems.title: What is React?
accordionItems.content: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.

accordionItems.title: What is useState?
accordionItems.content: useState is a React Hook used for managing local component state.

accordionItems.title: What is JSX?
accordionItems.content: JSX allows writing HTML-like syntax inside JavaScript.

expectedOutput: Only one active section visible at a time
accessibility: Use button elements for accordion headers.
performanceConsiderations: Use React.memo for AccordionItem if required.
Lazy-render hidden content for large datasets.
commonMistakes: Using array index as React key.
Not collapsing an already open item.
followUpQuestions: How would you allow multiple sections to stay open?
How would you add smooth animations?
How would you persist state after page refresh?
How would you make the component reusable?
How would you support nested accordions?

highLevel: Store currently expanded accordion item in state.
Compare clicked item with active item.
algorithm: Attach click handler to each header.
Update activeIndex based on clicked item.
Render content only for active item.
